books.title: Summer
books.art_why: Real-world summer scenes and objects are best shown in photos.

pages.brief: The sun shines brightly in a clear sky, and warm summer sunshine fills the whole scene. Bright golden light spreads across the picture, making the sunshine the main subject. No people or other objects are shown at all.

Rain falls steadily from a cloudy sky, filling the whole scene with wet summer weather. Many drops of rain are visible as they come down, making the rain the main subject. No people or other objects are shown.

A sandy beach is shown beside calm water, stretching out under an open sky. The beach itself is the main subject, with soft sand and the shoreline clearly visible. No people or other objects are shown anywhere in the scene.

A single bright swimsuit is shown by itself in close view, with its straps and fabric clearly visible. It is displayed against a simple, plain background as the main object, and no person is wearing it.

A single round ball sits alone in a close-up view, shown clearly as the main object. Its surface and shape are easy to see against a simple background, with no people or other objects anywhere in the picture.

Bright, colourful flowers are shown growing together, with their petals and stems clearly visible. The flowers are the main subject, standing against a simple background with no people or other objects anywhere in the picture.

A bright summer garden is shown with growing plants and open ground, filling the whole scene. The garden is the main subject, and the warm summer setting is clear, with no people or other objects shown anywhere.

books.title: My School Bus
books.art_why: A real school bus, bench, and school are everyday things that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A yellow school bus and a school building appear together in a clear, simple view. The bus is parked near the school, and the building stands behind it. Both are easy to see, filling the scene with everyday places.

A paved walkway stretches forward in a clear, simple view. The path is smooth and open, with straight edges and a flat surface. It looks like a safe place to walk, and it leads ahead without any clutter or extra objects.

A simple wooden bench stands alone in a clear, plain view. It has a flat seat, a straight backrest, and sturdy legs. The bench looks empty and still, with plain boards and a basic shape that is easy to recognize.
A large yellow school bus fills a clear, simple view. It has a long body, rounded corners, and rows of dark windows along the side. The bus stands still, showing its front and side plainly.

A school bus door is shown in a clear, simple view. The door is tall and rectangular, with glass panels and a straight frame. It stands closed, filling the doorway, and its plain shape makes it easy to see.

A short set of metal steps is shown in a clear, simple view. The steps are flat and even, rising in a straight line with a simple rail-like edge. They look sturdy and plain, with a simple, useful shape.
A school bus seat is shown in a clear, simple view. The seat has a flat cushion and a straight back, with a plain, sturdy shape. It looks empty and clean, ready for use.
A school bus window is shown in a clear, simple view. The window is rectangular, with a smooth glass pane and a simple frame. It looks clean and clear, with a plain shape that is easy to recognize.

A school building is shown in a clear, simple view. The building has a straight front, a simple roof, and plain walls. It stands still and easy to see, filling the scene with a familiar everyday place.

books.title: Lunch at School
books.art_why: Real children, bags, and school lunch foods can be photographed.

pages.brief: A young child stands in a school lunchroom with a few friends nearby. The child’s bag rests beside them. The friends are close together, and the child looks toward them. The bag is clearly the child’s own bag in the school setting.
The child’s milk and noodles sit together on the lunch table. The milk is beside the noodles, and both are in front of the child. The child’s lunch foods are ready for them at school.
The child’s carrots and cookie are on the lunch table. The carrots are beside the cookie, and both are in front of the child. These are the child’s lunch foods, ready to eat at school.
The child’s napkin and lunch are on the table. The napkin sits beside the lunch, and the child’s meal is ready in front of them. The child is at school with their lunch set out.

books.title: Colorful Eggs
books.art_why: Eggs are real objects that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A single red egg is shown alone, smooth and bright red. It rests in plain view as the only subject, with no other objects around it, giving young readers a clear, simple look at the color red.

A single yellow egg is shown alone, smooth and bright yellow. It rests in plain view as the only subject, with no other objects around it, giving young readers a clear, simple look at the color yellow.
A single pink egg is shown alone, smooth and bright pink. It rests in plain view as the only subject, with no other objects around it, giving young readers a clear, simple look at the color pink.

A single purple egg is shown alone, smooth and bright purple. It rests in plain view as the only subject, with no other objects around it, giving young readers a clear, simple look at the color purple.

A single orange egg is shown alone, smooth and bright orange. It rests in plain view as the only subject, with no other objects around it, giving young readers a clear, simple look at the color orange.
A single green egg is shown alone, smooth and bright green. It rests in plain view as the only subject, with no other objects around it, giving young readers a clear, simple look at the color green.
A single blue egg is shown alone, smooth and bright blue. It rests in plain view as the only subject, with no other objects around it, giving young readers a clear, simple look at the color blue.

A single colorful egg is shown alone, covered in several bright colors. It rests in plain view as the only subject, with no other objects around it, presenting a simple, cheerful final image for young readers to look at.

books.title: The Street
books.art_why: A street, gate, mailbox and bike are everyday real-world things a camera can photograph today.

pages.brief: A front gate of a house on a quiet street, standing closed between two posts at the edge of the yard. The gate is the only thing in view, seen straight on from the pavement, with a little of the wall on either side and open sky above it.

A mailbox fixed beside the street, its box and door facing the viewer, lid shut. It stands on its post at the edge of the yard, with nothing else drawing the eye, and the plain ground and sky behind it keep the mailbox the one clear thing in the picture.

A stretch of sidewalk running along the street, pale and flat, with its edge and the ground beside it clearly shown. Nobody walks on it. The path fills the picture from front to back so a young viewer can see exactly what a sidewalk looks like.

A fence beside the street, its posts and rails running in a line across the picture. It is closed and empty, with the ground below it and the sky above, and nothing else in front of or behind it, so the fence is the single thing to look at.

Flowers growing together in a small group, petals and green stems open and clear, planted beside the street. No one is picking them. The flowers fill the middle of the picture, with the ground they grow from beneath them and open space around them.

A bike standing on the street, both wheels on the ground, handlebars and seat in view, nobody riding it. It rests where it was left, seen from the side, with the plain ground under the wheels and the empty space around it.

A friend standing on the street, looking toward the viewer with a happy, open face. The friend is the whole picture, standing still with hands easy at their sides, the ground beneath their feet and the ordinary street behind them.

books.title: Two
books.art_why: Real animals and children can be photographed, so photos suit this simple counting book.

pages.brief: Show exactly two bees together as the only subjects. The page should make the number two clear by presenting a pair of bees. Do not add flowers, a hive, or any other animals. Keep the background simple so the two bees are the focus.

Show exactly two fish together as the only subjects. The page should clearly present a pair of fish to show the number two. Do not add water plants, bubbles, or other animals. Keep the scene simple so the two fish are the main focus.

Show exactly two birds together as the only subjects. The page should clearly present a pair of birds to show the number two. Do not add nests, trees, or other animals. Keep the background simple so the two birds are the main focus.

Show exactly two cats together as the only subjects. The page should clearly present a pair of cats to show the number two. Do not add toys, bowls, or other animals. Keep the background simple so the two cats are the main focus.

Show exactly two dogs together as the only subjects. The page should clearly present a pair of dogs to show the number two. Do not add balls, leashes, or other animals. Keep the background simple so the two dogs are the main focus.

Show exactly two cows together as the only subjects. The page should clearly present a pair of cows to show the number two. Do not add barns, fields, or other animals. Keep the background simple so the two cows are the main focus.

Show exactly two horses together as the only subjects. The page should clearly present a pair of horses to show the number two. Do not add riders, fences, or other animals. Keep the background simple so the two horses are the main focus.

Show exactly two kids together as the only subjects. The page should clearly present two children to show the number two. Do not add toys, adults, or other animals. Keep the background simple so the two kids are the main focus.

books.title: Four
books.art_why: Buses, wagons, cars, carts, airplanes, boats, trucks, and vans are real vehicles that can be photographed today.

pages.brief: Four buses are shown together, each with a long body, windows, and wheels, arranged so all four are easy to see. The scene focuses clearly on the buses themselves and gives a simple, close view of four real passenger vehicles.
Four wagons are shown together, each with a flat or boxy carrying bed and wheels, placed so all four can be seen at once. The view keeps the focus on these four real wagons and their simple shapes.

Four cars are shown together, each with a rounded body, windows, and wheels, set out clearly so all four are visible. The scene focuses on the cars themselves and keeps the view simple for counting four real vehicles.
Four carts are shown together, each with a small body, wheels, and a simple frame, arranged so all four can be seen. The view keeps attention on the four real carts and their basic parts.

Four airplanes are shown together, each with wings, a body, and a tail, placed so all four can be seen clearly. The scene focuses on the airplanes themselves and gives a simple view of four real aircraft.
Four boats are shown together, each with a hull and a simple deck area, arranged so all four are easy to see. The view keeps the focus on the boats themselves and their basic shapes.
Four trucks are shown together, each with a cab, a cargo area, and wheels, set out so all four can be counted. The scene focuses on these four real trucks and their simple, sturdy shapes.

Four vans are shown together, each with a boxy body, windows, and wheels, placed so all four are clearly visible. The view keeps attention on the vans themselves and gives a simple look at four real vehicles.

books.title: Rainforest Animals
books.art_why: Rainforest animals are real creatures living today, so photographs show them truly.

pages.brief: A wide view of a green rainforest: tall trees with thick trunks, big leaves and hanging vines fill the picture from the ground up to the leafy top. Sunlight filters down through the wet leaves, and a few small animals can be seen resting among the branches and foliage.

A wild cat stands on a thick, mossy branch in the rainforest, its spotted fur blending with the dappled light. Its paws grip the bark, its tail hangs down, and behind it are dark green leaves and tangled vines dripping with moisture.

A monkey hangs from a leafy branch in the rainforest, one long arm holding on while its body swings below. Its face turns toward the viewer, and around it are dense green leaves, thin vines and the blurred trunks of tall trees.

A bright frog sits still on a broad, wet green leaf in the rainforest, its legs folded and its eyes raised. Water droplets rest on its smooth skin and on the leaf, and soft green plants and shadowy stems fill the background behind it.

A colourful parrot perches on a branch in the rainforest, its clawed feet curled around the wood and its head turned to one side. Its bright feathers stand out against the deep green leaves and thin vines surrounding it.

A long snake lies coiled around a rainforest branch, its patterned body looping over the bark and its head raised slightly. Leaves and hanging vines fill the space around it, with dim green forest behind.

A butterfly rests with open wings on a rainforest flower, its thin legs touching the petals. Bright patterns cover the wings, and around it are wet green leaves, small blossoms and the soft blurred shapes of forest plants.

A beetle crawls across a fallen log in the rainforest, its hard shiny shell and small legs clearly visible. Bits of moss and damp bark surround it, with green leaves and stems rising behind the log in the shadows.

The whole rainforest spreads out in a wide green view: layers of tall trees, broad leaves, ferns and vines, with mist drifting between the trunks. Light falls in patches through the canopy onto the damp ground and the crowded plants below.

books.title: Plains Animals
books.art_why: The book shows real plains animals that can be photographed today.

pages.text: Plains Plains Animals Animals Written and Illustrated by Nora Voutas.
pages.brief: A wide, open plains setting introduces the book, with no specific animal named on this opening page. The view stays simple and general, quietly preparing for the named animals that follow on the next pages.
A fox stands alone on the open plains, the only animal shown on this page. The fox is seen in a simple, clear view with the grassy plains around it and nothing else added to the scene.
A single elephant stands on the open plains, the only animal shown on this page. The elephant is seen in a simple, clear view with grassy plains around it, and no other animals or objects are added.
A giraffe stands alone on the open plains, the only animal shown on this page. The giraffe is seen in a simple, clear view with grassy plains around it, and no other animals or objects are added.

A lion stands alone on the open plains, the only animal shown on this page. The lion is seen in a simple, clear view with grassy plains around it, and no other animals or objects are added to the scene.

A zebra stands alone on the open plains, the only animal shown on this page. The zebra is seen in a simple, clear view with grassy plains around it, and no other animals or objects are added to the scene.
An ostrich stands alone on the open plains, the only animal shown on this page. The ostrich is seen in a simple, clear view with grassy plains around it, and no other animals or objects are added.
A crocodile is shown alone on this page, the only animal in the plains setting. The crocodile is seen in a simple, clear view with open land around it, and no other animals or objects are added.

A wide view of the plains alone, with no animal shown on this page. The open grassy land fills the scene, simple and clear, as the final page quietly returns to the plains themselves with no other details added.

books.title: Blue
books.art_why: Sky, helmet, bike, bottle, bench, swing, slide and playground are all real objects that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A wide open sky fills the whole picture, bright and clear blue from top to bottom. There are no clouds, no trees and no buildings, just a smooth even stretch of blue above, the kind of sky seen on a calm sunny day.

A single blue safety helmet sits alone in the middle of a plain light surface, its strap hanging loose at the side and its shiny rounded shell catching soft daylight. Nothing else is nearby, no head and no bicycle, just the helmet resting by itself.

A blue bicycle stands upright on a flat path, handlebars turned slightly, pedals still, both wheels resting on the ground. The frame and fenders are all the same blue, and the bike is shown alone with nothing else in the scene around it.

A blue water bottle stands straight up on a plain surface, its cap screwed on tight and its body smooth and evenly coloured. It is shown close and alone, with nothing else in the frame, no hands and no bag, just the bottle by itself.

A blue bench sits empty in a simple outdoor spot, its slatted seat and back all painted the same blue, its legs firm on the ground. Nobody and nothing else appears in the picture; the bench simply stands there in plain view.

A blue swing hangs from its frame by two chains, the seat empty and still, not moving. The chains, the seat and the frame are all blue, and the swing is shown alone against a plain background with nobody sitting on it.

A blue slide curves down to the ground, its steps and sloping chute all painted the same blue. Nobody is on it or near it. The slide stands by itself in the picture, its edges smooth and clean, resting on flat ground.

A blue playground appears as a whole: the blue slide, the blue swing, the blue bench and other blue play equipment grouped together on open ground. Nobody is there. All the pieces share the same blue colour, standing quiet and empty.

books.title: Orange
books.art_why: Every subject is a real thing that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A single tree stands alone, its whole canopy glowing bright orange. The trunk is brown and the branches spread wide. The tree fills most of the view, with a soft, plain sky behind it and open ground below.
One single leaf lies against a plain background. The leaf is a strong orange colour from tip to stem, with clear veins running through it. It is shown close up, filling the middle of the view.
A round orange pumpkin rests on the ground. Its ribbed skin is deep orange all over, and a short brown stem sits on top. The pumpkin is shown by itself, filling the centre of the view.

A single flower blooms in close view. Its petals are bright orange and open wide around a small centre. A thin green stem holds the flower up. The flower stands alone against a soft, plain background.
An orange butterfly rests with its wings spread open. The wings are bright orange with thin dark edges. The butterfly sits on a plain surface, shown close up so its shape and colour fill the view.
An orange snake lies coiled on the ground. Its long body is bright orange, with scales catching the light. The snake's head lifts slightly at one end. It fills the view against a plain background.

A wide open field stretches out to the horizon. The whole field is a rich orange colour, with soft, rolling ground. Nothing else stands in the field. The orange field fills most of the view beneath a pale sky.

The sun sets low on the horizon, filling the sky with orange. The sky glows deep orange above a dark, flat horizon line. The bright orange sunset spreads across the whole view, with soft bands of colour.

books.title: Green
books.art_why: All subjects are real animals, plants and a forest that exist today.

pages.brief: A single green snake is shown alone in close view, its long body curved and its head visible. The snake’s scales are clearly green. Nothing else appears in the frame; the focus stays on the snake itself.
One green leaf is shown alone, filling the view. Its green surface and shape are clear, and it appears by itself with no other plant parts around it. The leaf is the only subject in the frame.
A patch of green moss is shown alone in close view. The moss looks soft and dense, with a clear green color across its surface. It is the only subject in the frame, with nothing else around it.
A green frog is shown alone in close view. Its green skin and body shape are clear, and it sits by itself as the only subject in the frame. Nothing else appears around the frog.

A green bird is shown alone in close view. Its green feathers and body are clear, and the bird appears by itself as the only subject in the frame. Nothing else is around it. The focus stays on the bird.

A green insect is shown alone in close view. Its green body and small form are clear, and it appears by itself as the only subject in the frame. Nothing else is around it. The focus stays on the insect.

A green lizard is shown alone in close view. Its green skin and body shape are clear, and it appears by itself as the only subject in the frame. Nothing else is around it. The focus stays on the lizard.
A green forest is shown, full of green trees and leaves. The whole view is green, with many trees standing together as a forest. The forest is the only subject shown. The view stays on the forest.

books.title: Yellow
books.art_why: A bus, cab, traffic light and safety vest are everyday real-world things a camera can show.

pages.brief: One bright yellow bus seen from the side on a sunny street, its big windows and wheels clearly visible, standing still at the edge of the road with clean pavement and sky around it.
A single yellow traffic light glowing brightly on a grey post at a street corner, shining against a clear daytime sky, with the dark housing of the signal around it.
A yellow cab driving along a city street in daylight, its doors and roof plainly yellow, wheels on the road, plain buildings and sky behind it.
A row of yellow road signs standing on metal posts beside a street, square and bright against the sky, seen close up so their flat yellow faces fill the view.
A big yellow truck parked on a paved road in daylight, showing its cab and large wheels, with plain ground and open sky around it.
A person wearing a bright yellow safety vest over their clothes, standing outdoors in daylight, the vest clear and plain across their chest and shoulders.
Yellow painted lines running along the surface of a road in daylight, bright and straight on the grey ground, stretching away in a simple clear view.
A yellow hat resting in view outdoors in daylight, its brim and crown clearly yellow, shown simply against a plain bright background.

books.title: These Birds
books.art_why: Real birds living today are best shown in photographs.

pages.brief: Four pale grey doves stand close together on a low wooden fence in a sunny garden, their smooth rounded bodies facing forward, one turning its head to the side, soft green grass and blurred leaves behind them.
Two hawks perch on a bare branch high above open ground, broad wings folded, hooked beaks turned forward, brown streaked feathers on their chests, clear blue sky stretching behind the branch.
Three glossy black crows stand on short grass in a field, thick beaks slightly open, dark feathers shining, tails straight down, one crow stepping forward while the others look around.
Two owls sit side by side on a thick tree branch, round flat faces turned toward the viewer, large dark eyes wide open, soft mottled brown feathers, dim green leaves blurred behind them.
A pair of large eagles rests on a rocky ledge, wide wings partly spread, white heads and heavy yellow beaks, strong talons gripping the stone, pale sky and distant hills behind them.
A small flock of geese walks along a grassy bank near calm water, long necks stretched up, grey and brown bodies, wide webbed feet on the ground, one goose bending its head down.
Two turkeys stand in a farmyard on bare earth, dark feathers and red wattles, one bird spreading its tail feathers into a wide fan while the other walks past, wooden fence behind them.

books.title: City Street
books.art_why: Modern city street elements exist in real life and can be photographed.

pages.brief: Show a set of steps on a city street, wide and clear in the foreground. The steps are the only subject, with no people, vehicles, or other objects added. They sit plainly in view so the page stays focused on the steps.

Show a sidewalk on a city street, flat and clear in the foreground. The sidewalk is the only subject, with no people, vehicles, food, or buildings added. It stretches plainly across the view so the simple page stays focused on the sidewalk.

Show food as the main subject in a simple city street setting. The food is plainly visible, with no people, vehicles, buildings, or other objects added around it. The focus stays only on the food so the page stays focused on the food.

Show city buildings as the main subject, standing together along the street. The buildings are tall and clear in the view, with no people, vehicles, food, steps, or sidewalk details added. They fill the scene so the page stays focused on the buildings.

Show one taxi on the city street, clear and easy to see. The taxi is the main subject, with no people, bus, food, buildings, or extra objects added. It is shown plainly in the street view so the page stays focused on the taxi.

Show one bus on the city street, clear and easy to see. The bus is the main subject, with no people, taxi, food, buildings, or extra objects added. It is shown plainly in the street view so the page stays focused on the bus.

Show people on the city street, together and clearly visible. The people are the main subject, with no vehicles, food, buildings, or extra objects added. They are simply present in the street view so the page stays focused on the people.

Show the city street itself, open and clear across the view. The street is the main subject, with no people, vehicles, food, buildings, steps, or sidewalk details added. It fills the scene plainly so the page stays focused on the street.

books.title: Picking Apples
books.art_why: Farmers, tractors, orchards and apples are real things that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A bright apple orchard on a sunny day, with ripe red apples hanging on leafy branches. A person’s hands reach up to pick one apple from a branch, while more apples wait nearby. The scene shows the beginning of apple picking among the trees.

A farmer stands in an apple orchard, wearing work clothes and a hat, looking toward the apple trees. The farmer is outdoors among the rows of trees, ready to work. Sunlight falls on the orchard and on the farmer’s clothing.

A farm tractor sits in an apple orchard, with large rear wheels and a sturdy body. The tractor is parked on grassy ground between rows of apple trees. Its metal and paint look clean in the daylight, and the orchard stretches around it.

A tall apple tree stands in an orchard, its leafy branches spread wide. Ripe apples hang among the green leaves. The trunk is sturdy and the tree grows from grassy ground, filling the view under soft daylight.
A woven basket sits on grassy ground in an orchard. The basket is empty, with a sturdy handle and a wide open top. Daylight falls on the woven strands, and the basket waits among the apple trees.

A wooden ladder stands in an apple orchard, leaning upright near the trees. Its rungs are evenly spaced and its sides are sturdy. The ladder rests on grassy ground, ready for use among the orchard rows in the daylight.

A group of friends stands together in an apple orchard. The children are close to one another, smiling and looking friendly. They wear casual clothes and stand on grassy ground among the trees, enjoying being together outdoors.
A wooden wagon sits in an apple orchard, with a flat bed and side rails. The wagon rests on grassy ground near the trees. Its wheels are sturdy, and daylight shows the wood and metal parts clearly.

Ripe red apples are gathered together in a pile. The apples are round and shiny, with smooth skin and small stems. They sit close together, filling the view with bright color under soft daylight. The apples look fresh and ready to eat.

books.title: Valentine's Day Gifts
books.art_why: All the gifts are real, everyday objects that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A soft, bright tabletop holds a cheerful group of Valentine gifts: a bouquet of red flowers, a plate of cookies, a bunch of balloons, a bowl of candy, a small teddy bear, a box of chocolates and a card, all arranged together in warm pink and red colors.

Several wrapped gifts sit together on a clean tabletop, covered in red, pink and white paper with ribbons and bows. The packages are different sizes, clustered in the middle of the frame under soft, bright light, with plenty of empty space around them.

A bouquet of fresh flowers stands on a plain tabletop, with red and pink blooms and green leaves. The flowers are gathered closely together, facing the viewer, in soft daylight. The background is simple and light so the petals and leaves stand out clearly.

A plate of round cookies rests on a clean tabletop, decorated with pink and red icing in simple patterns. The cookies are stacked slightly and spread across the plate. Soft light falls on them, and the background is plain and bright, keeping the plate as the main subject.

A bunch of red and pink balloons floats above a plain floor, tied together with ribbons. The balloons are round and smooth, catching soft light, and they fill the upper part of the frame. The background is simple and light, with no people or furniture.

A bowl of colorful candy sits on a clean tabletop, with small wrapped sweets and heart-shaped pieces in red, pink and white. The candy is piled together, filling the bowl. Soft light shines on the shiny wrappers, and the background is plain and bright.

A soft teddy bear sits upright on a plain surface, with light brown fur and a small red ribbon. The bear faces forward, its rounded ears and paws clearly visible. Soft light falls on the fur, and the background is simple and light so the bear stands out.

An open box of chocolates rests on a clean tabletop, showing neat rows of small chocolates in different shapes. The box is square, with red and pink packaging around the edges. Soft light falls on the chocolates, and the background is plain and bright.

A single Valentine card stands upright on a plain tabletop, with a red heart on the front and a simple folded shape. The card faces the viewer, slightly open, in soft light. The background is clean and light, with nothing else around it.

books.title: Black
books.art_why: All the items are real objects that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A single black stage fills the view. The stage is completely black, with a flat floor and open space, standing alone as the only thing shown. Nothing else is on or around it, and the whole scene is simple and clear.

One black sheet is shown by itself. The sheet is spread out and completely black, with soft folds and edges, resting alone in a plain space. It is the only object in the picture, clear and simple to see.
One black suit is shown by itself. The suit is a matching jacket and trousers in deep black, standing alone in a plain space. It is the only object in the picture, neat and clear to look at.
One black tie is shown by itself. The tie is long and dark black, hanging straight down alone in a plain space. It is the only object in the picture, simple and clear to see.
One black cape is shown by itself. The cape is a long black cloth with a wide shape, hanging alone in a plain space. It is the only object in the picture, clear and simple to look at.
One black hat is shown by itself. The hat is dark black with a clear shape, sitting alone in a plain space. It is the only object in the picture, simple and clear to see.
One black wand is shown by itself. The wand is a thin black stick, held out alone in a plain space. It is the only object in the picture, clear and simple to look at.
One black rabbit is shown by itself. The rabbit is completely black, sitting alone in a plain space. It is the only animal in the picture, clear and simple to see.

books.title: White
books.art_why: The book names real animals, plants, snow and an igloo, all photographable today.

pages.brief: White snow covers the ground in a broad, soft layer. The surface is pale and even, filling the whole scene. Nothing else is shown on the white snow. The snow lies calm and still across the open view.

White flowers are shown with their white petals open. The blooms are pale and clear, standing close together in the scene. No other colors are named for the flowers. They are the main subject shown here.

A white fox is shown with pale fur, pointed ears and a bushy tail. It stands alert and looks forward. Its white coat blends into the pale background around it. The fox is the only animal in the scene.

A large white whale is shown with a smooth white body and a broad tail. It swims through the water, its pale shape filling the scene. The whale is the only subject shown. Its white body stands out against the water around it.
A white seal is shown with soft pale fur and dark eyes. It rests on a white surface, its rounded body close to the ground. The seal looks calm and still. It is the only animal in the scene.

Several white eggs are shown together, smooth and rounded. Their shells are white and clean. They sit close to one another, filling the center of the scene. The eggs are the only subjects shown in view.

A white owl is shown with pale feathers and large eyes. It sits still, facing forward, with its rounded head and soft wings visible. Its white body stands out against the background behind it. The owl is the only animal in the scene.

A white igloo stands in a cold white setting. Its rounded shape is made of white snow, and an opening is visible on one side. The igloo is alone in the scene. The white structure fills the center of the view.

books.title: The Baseball Game
books.art_why: Baseball fields and equipment are real things that exist today.

pages.brief: A wide view of a baseball field outdoors, with the grassy outfield and dirt infield visible under open sky. The field is empty and still, ready for a game, and the scene focuses only on the field itself.
A baseball base sits firmly on the dirt of the infield. The square white base is shown close and clear, resting in its proper spot on the field, with the surrounding dirt and a little grass nearby.
A baseball bat is shown clearly as the main object, with its long barrel and handle visible. It rests in a simple outdoor setting near the dirt of the baseball field, with no players around.
A baseball is shown close up, round and stitched, resting on the dirt of the field. The ball sits still in the open outdoor setting, clearly the object in view, with the ground around it visible.
